jobs.title: Business Manager
jobs.description:
About kwikSocio

kwikSocio is an AI-powered digital marketing and social-media automation platform that helps businesses create content, publish across multiple channels, engage customers, generate quality leads and manage marketing performance from one intelligent dashboard.

Role Overview

We are looking for an energetic and result-oriented Business Manager to manage social-media marketing, acquire customers through direct sales and develop partnerships with content creators and influencers.

The candidate will be responsible for promoting kwikSocio, meeting prospective customers, presenting product demonstrations, executing marketing activities and converting business opportunities into subscriptions.

Key Responsibilities

Social Media Marketing

Plan and execute social-media marketing campaigns.

Create promotional ideas for posts, reels, advertisements and digital campaigns.

Coordinate content creation, scheduling and publishing across social platforms.

Improve brand awareness, audience engagement and lead generation.

Monitor campaign performance and prepare marketing reports.

Identify current social-media trends and promotional opportunities.

Coordinate with designers, content writers and campaign teams.

Direct Sales and Business Development

Identify prospective customers in Hyderabad and surrounding markets.

Meet business owners, professionals, agencies and organisations directly.

Present and demonstrate kwikSocio’s features and subscription plans.

Generate leads through field visits, calls, WhatsApp, email, networking and social media.

Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable solutions.

Prepare proposals, quotations and sales presentations.

Follow up with prospects and convert them into paying customers.

Achieve monthly customer-acquisition and revenue targets.

Maintain an organised sales pipeline and submit regular performance reports.

Support new customers during onboarding and product adoption.

Creator and Influencer Partnerships

Identify content creators, influencers and promotional partners.

Build and maintain professional relationships with creators.

Negotiate campaign deliverables, timelines and commercial terms.

Coordinate creator-led campaigns for kwikSocio and its customers.

Monitor creator performance, engagement and campaign results.

Develop long-term collaborations with creators and marketing partners.

Required Skills

Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

Knowledge of social-media marketing and digital promotions.

Interest in direct sales, business development and customer acquisition.

Confidence in attending customer meetings and conducting product demonstrations.

Ability to build relationships with business owners, creators and influencers.

Good follow-up, reporting and time-management skills.

Self-motivated, target-oriented and willing to work in the field.

Basic knowledge of CRM systems, Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.

Fluency in English and Telugu is preferred; Hindi will be an advantage.

Two-wheeler and willingness to travel locally within Hyderabad will be advantageous.

Eligibility

Any graduate or postgraduate may apply.

MBA in Marketing or Sales is an advantage but not mandatory.

Freshers with strong communication and sales aptitude are welcome.

Candidates with up to three years of experience in social-media marketing, direct sales, SaaS sales, digital marketing, influencer marketing or business development will be preferred.

Compensation

₹25,000–₹40,000 per month, depending on experience, skills and interview performance.

Performance-based incentives and career-growth opportunities may be provided according to company policy.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Business management: 3 years (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 50% (Required)

,

**win together**
and

in our work.

* Strong Python proficiency with experience in AI/ML workflows and automation systems.

The IE IoT Software Program Manager is responsible for driving end‑to‑end execution of Qualcomm’s Linux platform initiatives with a strong emphasis on upstream alignment, open-source excellence, distribution enablement, lifecycle management, and the productization of industrial‑grade IoT solutions.
  
  
This role demands exceptional cross‑functional leadership, deep expertise in embedded Linux development ecosystems, and the ability to orchestrate execution across kernel, Yocto, Debian/Ubuntu, user‑space frameworks, CI pipelines, and industrial solution teams. A customer‑first approach, cost‑efficient decision making, and proven experience transforming prototypes into robust, production‑ready industrial solutions are essential.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Linux Platform & Upstream Leadership**

* Define and lead mainline alignment, upstreaming strategies, and branch lifecycle management across mainline, LTS, and stable trees.
* Oversee open‑source compliance, release coordination, and adherence to Qualcomm’s Linux‑first execution strategy.
* Ensure predictable upstream refresh cadences across kernel, Yocto, and Debian/Ubuntu ecosystems

**Distro Enablement & Ecosystem Integration**

* Drive end‑to‑end enablement across Yocto, Debian, and Ubuntu distributions, including graphics, multimedia, AI/ML, connectivity, robotics, and industrial frameworks.
* Champion developer‑first workflows, upstream‑friendly integration practices, and clear, high‑quality open‑source documentation.

**Productization & Industrial IoT Solution Readiness**

* Convert platform capabilities and prototypes into stable, repeatable, production‑grade industrial IoT solutions.
* Integrate key industrial protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, EtherCAT, Profinet, MQTT, CoAP, etc.) into platform roadmaps and solution blueprints.
* Drive cost‑optimized decision making across feature sets, cloud usage, and hardware/software selections.

**Customer Engagement & Solutions Engineering**

* Maintain strong customer focus—translate customer needs into actionable, prioritized engineering workflows.
* Lead solution prototyping, PoCs, and integration efforts by coordinating across functional teams.
* Deliver developer‑grade documentation, solution guides, and production‑ready reference implementations.

**Cross‑Functional Program Leadership**

* Manage large cross‑functional execution spanning kernel, multimedia, Android, connectivity, user space, and partner teams that includes the HW platform teams.
* Own schedules, milestone alignment, dependency mapping, risk management, and executive communications.
* Ensure Linux‑first, developer‑first discipline across the entire engineering pipeline.

**Quality, Testing & Automation Excellence**

* Drive strong pre‑merge validation, CI/CD health, and continuous testing coverage across mainline and LTS branches.
* Track quality regressions across features, drive closure with partner teams, and uphold production‑readiness KPIs.

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* 10–15+ years of leadership experience within embedded Linux/Kernel/Yocto/Open‑Source ecosystems.
* Deep understanding of:

+ Upstream Linux development workflows (maintainers, linux‑next, LTS/stable branches).
+ Kernel branching models, mainline alignment, Yocto/OE pipelines, and Debian/Ubuntu packaging and workflows.
+ Open‑source contribution processes (patch submission, review cycles, Gerrit/Git workflows).

* Demonstrated success managing complex, multi‑disciplinary engineering programs.
* Exceptional communication skills and strong stakeholder management with a risk‑driven decision mindset.

**Preferred**

* Experience with industrial IoT systems, industrial protocols, or Linux‑based industrial platforms.
* Background in prototyping, customer‑facing engineering, or productizing industrial IoT software stacks.

jobs.title: Digital Product Mgr-AI&D
jobs.description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**Digital Product Manager (AI)**
The Digital Product Manager at Amgen oversees the lifecycle of digital products, working closely with various teams to define the product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Digital Product Manager, to join the AI & Data Innovation Lab Product Management Team. This role is focused on rapidly validating high-potential AI and data-driven business opportunities before major investment, helping Amgen determine which AI initiatives should be scaled, refined, paused, or redirected.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of business strategy, AI product innovation, data, technology, and enterprise transformation, this role will provide strategic product leadership across ambiguous, cross-functional opportunities and influence senior business and technology stakeholders on product direction, prioritization, investment, and scale.
  
  
This role requires a strong product mindset, sufficient technical depth to evaluate whether AI and data opportunities are practical, scalable, measurable, and aligned to Amgen’s enterprise technology direction. The successful candidate will understand how AI products are built, validated, deployed, monitored, and scaled in complex enterprise environments.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design and execute rapid discovery sprints, prototypes, pilots, user research, and experiments to assess desirability, feasibility, viability, value, and risk. Use evidence to determine whether opportunities should advance, pivot, pause, or scale.
* Identify, frame, and validate AI-enabled business opportunities across Amgen. Translate broad transformation themes into clear problem statements, testable hypotheses, user needs, data requirements, success metrics, and validation plans.
* Assess how LLMs, AI agents, machine learning models, NLP, automation, knowledge retrieval, analytics, and intelligent workflow tools can improve productivity, decision quality, scientific discovery, operational efficiency, and workforce effectiveness.
* Evaluate whether proposed AI opportunities have the right data foundations, system integrations, architecture patterns, model capabilities, security controls, and operational support needed to move from concept to scalable solution.
* Partner with engineering, data science, and technical teams to align on scope, tradeoffs, and execution path.
* Conduct landscape assessments across different industries to learn how AI is leveraged to solve shared problem spaces at the macro level.
* Develop product requirements that account for user experience, data availability, model performance, output quality, explainability, reliability, latency, integration needs, governance, and ongoing measurement.
* Synthesize findings from validation work into clear product recommendations, opportunity briefs, technical feasibility assessments, business cases, and executive-ready narratives. Help leaders make informed decisions about where to invest, scale, or stop.
* Ensure validation efforts consider responsible AI, data privacy, model risk, cybersecurity, compliance, regulatory considerations, human oversight, change management, and enterprise scalability from the earliest stages of discovery.
* Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, prioritization discussions, technical feasibility reviews, user experience design, process mapping, and decision forums. Communicate complex AI and data concepts in a clear, business-oriented way for senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 8-13 years of work experience in the related field
* Doctorate; or Master’s degree and 2 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or
* Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or
* Associate’s degree and 8 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or
* High School Diploma or GED and 10 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of product management, product strategy, innovation, consulting, digital transformation, or related experience.
* 2+ years of experience with AI, machine learning, data products, automation, LLMs, agents, NLP, analytics, or enterprise AI solutions.
* Working knowledge of AI product development, including discovery, prototyping, model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
* Familiarity with generative AI, LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, prompt engineering, model orchestration, NLP, predictive analytics, or intelligent automation.
* Design thinking experience
* Ability to evaluate AI opportunities across desirability, feasibility, viability, value, risk, scalability, and data readiness.
* Experience with AI platforms, MLOps, or enterprise AI…

jobs.description:
**We're looking for a**
****Principal Product Manager - HR Platforms & Technology****
**This role is**
**Office Based, Hyderabad Office**
**Principal Product Manager | HR Technology & Platforms | Hyderabad**
**Summary**
Cornerstone OnDemand is seeking a Principal Product Manager to grow our performance and talent management agent portfolio, leading the delivery of AI-native products and enterprise outcome agents that drive measurable customer value.
  
  
This is a customer-facing AI-native product management role for a hands-on PM who can move quickly from customer discovery and requirements to working prototypes, using modern AI-native product development tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co-Pilot and similar platforms. The role requires close collaboration with customers, FDEs, engineering, and cross-functional teams to validate solutions early, iterate rapidly, and launch outcome agents that solve meaningful business problems. As our agent portfolio grows, individual agents increasingly work together to compound value for customers, and this role will help shape how new agents fit into that broader picture.
  
  
The ideal candidate is highly execution-oriented, comfortable working in ambiguity, and able to translate customer needs into prototypes, product direction, and shipped capabilities with speed and rigor
  
  
**About The Team**
You'll join a growing product team building AI-native agents for the performance and talent management domain, part of a broader portfolio of enterprise outcome agents at Cornerstone. Our agents help enterprise customers connect everyday work to business outcomes, from goal-setting to performance reviews to coaching and development. As the portfolio expands, we're increasingly focused on how individual agents can work together to create more value than any single agent alone. This role is an opportunity to help shape that next chapter, taking ownership of new agent areas as the team grows.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
In your first 6 to 12 months, you will:
  
  

* Take end-to-end ownership of one or more new agent initiatives within the performance and talent domain, from customer discovery through working prototype.
* Build strong relationships with customers, FDEs, and engineering partners, establishing a fast, repeatable feedback loop between discovery and prototype iteration.
* Ship a working AI-native prototype that customers and internal stakeholders can review, test, and validate against real business problems.
* Identify meaningful opportunities for your agent(s) to complement others in the portfolio, contributing to how the team thinks about multi-agent value.
* Establish yourself as a trusted, execution-oriented voice on the team, someone who can take ambiguous customer problems and turn them into shipped product direction with minimal oversight

**In This Role You Will**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of new AI-native products and enterprise outcome agents within the performance and talent management domain, from customer discovery and requirements gathering through prototype creation, iteration, and launch.
* Partner directly with customers to understand business problems, workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes in performance management, goal-setting, and talent development.
* Translate customer needs into clear product requirements, use cases, and solution concepts that can quickly be tested and refined.
* Identify opportunities for new agents to complement existing ones in the portfolio, contributing to a cohesive experience as agents are increasingly deployed together.
* Build and evolve working prototypes using AI-native tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co-Pilot and similar rapid prototyping platforms, using prototypes as the new PRD motion so customers, FDEs, and engineering can review, test, and refine solutions directly.
* Collaborate closely with FDEs and engineering to validate feasibility, refine user flows, and prepare solutions for launch, working in tight feedback loops to confirm value and shape deliverable product capabilities.
* Drive cross-functional execution across product, engineering, design, data science, architecture, and go-to-market teams to bring validated concepts into production.
* Turn customer specific outcome agents into re-sellable out-of-the box agents.
* Ensure launched outcome agents are practical, scalable, and easy for enterprise customers to adopt.
* Use customer feedback, adoption signals, and business-impact metrics to continuously improve product execution and outcomes.

**You Have Got What It Takes If You Have**

* 5+ years of experience in product management, including significant experience delivering enterprise software, SaaS, AI, or platform products.
* Hands-on experience using AI-native prototyping and product development tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co-Pilot or similar tools to accelerate product definition and validation.
* Strong track record in customer-facing product delivery for enterprise SaaS or AI-native products.
* Demonstrated ability to go from customer discovery and requirements to working prototypes and launched solutions.
* Experience collaborating closely with customers and technical delivery partners such as FDEs to iterate rapidly and launch customer-ready solutions.
* Strong product execution skills, including prioritization, prototype validation, release planning, cross-functional coordination, and delivery tracking.
* Experience translating ambiguous customer problems into structured product requirements and testable product experiences.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast-moving, matrixed environments and drive alignment across technical and business teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the performance management or broader HR technology space, for example goal-setting platforms, performance review tools, or coaching and enablement platforms.

jobs.description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
  
  
Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
  
  
Reports To
  
  
VP / Strategic Data Lead
  
  
**Job Overview**
LPL Financial is seeking an Assistant Vice President, Data Product Owner (DPO) to own and manage individual Wealth Management (WM) data products. This role is responsible for day-to-day ownership, execution, and governance of assigned datasets, ensuring they are accurate, usable, and aligned with business needs.
  
  
The AVP DPO operates as the hands-on product owner, working closely with engineering, data stewards, and business stakeholders to define requirements, manage data quality, and drive adoption.
  
  
This is not a reporting or analytics role — it is an execution-focused data product ownership role with clear accountability for data quality, usability, and governance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
  
  
**Support Enterprise Initiatives By Ensuring Data Readiness And Clarity**

* Data Product Ownership & Execution. Act as the named Data Owner for specific WM data products. Define and maintain business definitions and metadata. Use cases and data consumers. Data quality rules and thresholds. Make decisions on fitness-for-purpose for assigned datasets. Data access approvals (within defined guardrails)
* Wealth Management Domain Support. Own data products within WM domains such as: Clients / Participants Accounts and transactions Securities and pricining
* Data Product Lifecycle Management: Execute lifecycle activities: Define → Build → Publish → Operate → Enhance
* Partner with delivery teams to ensure: Requirements are clear and actionable. Data considerations are embedded in delivery
* Data Quality & Issue Management: Identify and track Critical Data Elements (CDEs). Define data quality rules with Data Stewards. Monitor data quality metrics and trends. Drive remediation of data issues and defects
* Technical Partnership: Work closely with Data Custodians and Engineering to: Review data structures, transformations, and lineage. Support schema and contract changes. Translate business requirements into specifications. Utilize data governance and catalog tools
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with: Data Stewards, Engineering and platform teams Risk, Compliance, and Legal

**What are we looking for?**
We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates
**pursue greatness**
,
**act with integrity**
, and are
**driven to help our clients succeed**
. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we
**win together**
and
**create and share joy**
in our work.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 6–10+ years in Wealth Management or Financial Services
* Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools and platforms to identify and drive automation opportunities across data products.
* Ability to design, create, update, and onboard AI-driven agents to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency.
* Experience integrating AI capabilities into existing data product frameworks, including continuous optimization and governance.
* Strong understanding of emerging AI use cases and the ability to translate them into scalable, business-aligned solutions.
* Strong understanding of WM data domains and use cases
* Data product ownership, product management, or data governance

**Core Competencies**

* Strong ownership mindset and attention to detail
* Execution-focused and solution-oriented
* Clear communicator across business and technical teams
* Comfortable working in structured governance environments
* Establish clear ownership for assigned WM data products
* Deliver well-defined, governed, and consumable datasets
* Improve data quality and trust at the product level

jobs.title: Lead Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Lead Product Owner (LPO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is responsible for
**end‑to‑end ownership, consistency, and execution excellence across multiple data, analytics, and reporting products or domains**
. This role ensures alignment between business priorities, product strategy, and delivery execution.
  
  
The Lead Product Owner acts as the
**central accountability point across a portfolio of related products**
, coaching and guiding Product Owners, establishing standards, and partnering closely with Program Management, Data Engineering, and Governance to deliver predictable, high‑quality outcomes.
  
  
This role is critical to enabling
**product‑led execution at scale**
within the CDO.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio‑Level Product Ownership**

* Own the overall product vision and execution strategy across a defined product portfolio or domain (e.g., Reporting, Self‑Service Analytics, Finance Analytics, Data Platforms).
* Ensure each product has:

+ A clear purpose and roadmap
+ Defined success metrics
+ Consistent experience and standards

* Act as the final decision authority on prioritization, scope tradeoffs, and acceptance across related products.

**Leadership & Coaching**

* Lead, mentor, and coach Product Owners to ensure consistent product ownership practices and decision quality.
* Set and enforce standards for backlog quality, roadmap clarity, and stakeholder communication.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex prioritization, dependency, or scope conflicts.
* Raise the overall product ownership maturity across CDO.

**Stakeholder Alignment & Business Partnership**

* Serve as an interface between CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Translate enterprise priorities into sequenced, realistic roadmaps.
* Manage competing stakeholder demands by making transparent, value‑based trade‑offs.
* Ensure stakeholders have confidence in what will be delivered, when, and why.

**Roadmap, Backlog & Delivery Governance**

* Maintain a portfolio‑level roadmap, aligned with capacity, dependencies, and strategic priorities.
* Ensure Product Owners maintain well‑defined, ready backlogs that support predictable delivery.
* Partner with Program Managers and Scrum Masters to:

+ Align sprint and release plans
+ Surface risks and constraints early
+ Manage cross‑team dependencies

* Ensure delivery adheres to CDO governance, readiness, and release standards.

**Quality, Governance & Trust**

* Partner with Data Governance, Architecture, and Platform teams to:

+ Enforce consistent KPI definitions and semantic standards
+ Uphold data quality, lineage, and trust expectations
+ Ensure security and compliance requirements are met

* Ensure products are operationally ready and supported post‑release.

**Value Realization & Continuous Improvement**

* Define and track adoption, usage, and value metrics across the product portfolio.
* Ensure products deliver measurable business impact, not just functionality.
* Identify opportunities to:

+ Simplify or consolidate products
+ Reduce technical or vendor dependency
+ Improve scalability and user experience

* Continuously refine product direction based on feedback and performance insights.

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* 7+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Analytics/Data‑centric leadership roles.
* Proven experience owning multiple products or domains in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data, analytics, reporting, and BI platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
* Experience leading or mentoring other Product Owners or equivalent roles.

**Preferred**

* Experience within a Chief Data Office, Analytics COE, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Databricks, Power BI, semantic models, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience modernizing legacy reporting or analytics platforms.
* Background in professional services or financial services environments.

**Leadership Behaviors & Expectations**

* Thinks and acts portfolio‑first, not story‑by‑story.
* Brings clarity, structure, and discipline to ambiguity.
* Comfortable making—and defending—trade‑off decisions.
* Focused on outcomes, adoption, and trust, not just delivery.
* Acts as a role model for product ownership maturity.

**Role Relationships (Clarity of Accountability)**

* Lead Product Owner: Defines long‑term strategy, investment priorities, and value realization. Owns execution alignment, product standards, and delivery outcomes across a portfolio.
* Product Owners: Own day‑to‑day product execution and backlogs within specific domains.
* Program Managers: Own delivery coordination, milestones, and dependency management.

**Why This Role Matters**
The Lead Product Owner ensures CDO can
**scale product‑led execution without chaos**
, reducing reliance on individual heroics while increasing predictability, trust, and impact across enterprise data and analytics investments.

jobs.title: Program Manager - Technology
jobs.description:
* Full-time

**Company Description**
-----------------------

AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3.5 lakh (350,000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.

AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Role**

We are looking for a Technology Program Manager who can drive complex, cross-functional technology initiatives from problem definition to execution and delivery.  
  
This is not a traditional Scrum Master / Agile Project Manager role.  
  
You will work in an environment where requirements evolve, priorities change, teams may not be co-located, and there isn't always a well-defined process or single owner for every dependency.  
  
Your job will be to bring clarity, structure and momentum to these situations.  
  
You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations and external technology partners to ensure that complex initiatives move forward and eventually reach production.

**What You Will Do**

* Drive end-to-end technology programs — translate high-level objectives into clear plans, milestones, dependencies and execution paths.
* Navigate complex technical dependencies across multiple engineering teams, services, platforms and third-party systems.
* Work closely with engineering leads to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, system dependencies and technical constraints well enough to identify execution risks early.
* Identify the critical path for programs and continuously remove blockers that could impact delivery.
* Coordinate execution across distributed and non-co-located teams, ensuring alignment without relying purely on formal processes.
* Bring structure to ambiguous problems — figure out what needs to happen, who needs to be involved and how we get from where we are today to the desired outcome.
* Identify risks, dependencies and decisions proactively rather than waiting for issues to surface.
* Facilitate discussions between teams when there are conflicting priorities, unclear ownership or competing technical approaches.
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Managers to convert product/business objectives into executable technology plans.
* Maintain program visibility for leadership — what is on track, what is blocked, why it is blocked and what decisions are required.
* Manage execution across multiple parallel workstreams without becoming a task tracker.
* Work with external vendors/partners where technology integration or operational dependencies are involved.
* Establish lightweight processes where needed — but avoid adding process for the sake of process.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in Technical Program Management, Product Operations, Engineering Program Management, Technology Consulting or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of software development and technology systems. You don't need to be a coder, but you should be comfortable discussing APIs, databases, services, integrations, data flows, releases and system dependencies with engineers.
* Demonstrated experience driving cross-functional technology initiatives involving multiple teams.
* Strong ability to understand technical dependencies and identify risks before they become delivery problems.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly across teams with different priorities.
* Ability to operate effectively with distributed / geographically dispersed engineering teams.
* Strong ownership mindset — you see a problem through to resolution rather than simply escalating it.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to operate in a high-paced startup environment where processes are evolving continuously.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working in a consumer internet, marketplace, OTA, fintech, mobility or other high-scale technology environment.
* Experience working with microservices, APIs, cloud infrastructure or data platforms.
* Engineering / Computer Science background.
* Experience working with external technology vendors or partners.
* Experience managing programs involving multiple engineering teams and complex integrations.
* Experience in an environment where Product and Engineering operate with high autonomy and lightweight processes.

**What Success Looks Like**

After 6 months, you should be the person teams rely on to answer:

* What exactly are we trying to deliver?
* Which teams and systems are involved?
* What are the critical dependencies?
* What is blocking us?
* Who needs to make a decision?
* What can derail the program?
* What needs to happen next?

**You don't need to create more meetings or more status reports.**  
  
**You need to make complex things happen.**

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

jobs.description:
Corporate Credit Analyst

Department: Risk Management / Corporate Credit Risk

Location: Hyderabad

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 3–7 Years

About the Company

Venus FinTech is a growing FinTech company providing technology-driven financial solutions to businesses and corporates. The company offers a range of corporate lending and financial products designed to support business growth, working capital requirements, expansion, and other financial needs.

Job Responsibilities

Corporate Financial Analysis:

Analyse corporate balance sheets, profit & loss statements, cash flow statements, financial ratios, annual reports, and projected financial statements to assess the financial strength and repayment capacity of borrowers.

Corporate Credit Assessment:

Evaluate credit proposals for various corporate lending products, including working capital facilities, term loans, business loans, project finance, secured lending, and other corporate credit facilities.

Credit Risk Evaluation:

Assess the borrower's credit history, financial performance, debt obligations, repayment capacity, business model, management quality, industry outlook, and overall creditworthiness.

Working Capital Assessment:

Analyse working capital requirements, operating cycles, inventory, receivables, payables, banking transactions, and fund utilisation to determine appropriate credit limits.

Cash Flow & Debt Servicing Analysis:

Evaluate projected cash flows, DSCR, interest coverage, leverage, repayment schedules, and other financial indicators to determine the borrower's ability to service debt.

Collateral & Security Evaluation:

Review the quality and adequacy of collateral, securities, guarantees, and other risk-mitigation measures associated with the proposed credit facility.

Credit Appraisal & Recommendations:

Prepare detailed credit appraisal notes, credit assessment reports, and summary memos with clear recommendations for approval committees and senior management.

Financial Modelling:

Prepare and review financial models, projections, sensitivity analysis, and stress scenarios to assess the potential impact of changes in revenue, margins, interest rates, working capital, and other business conditions.

Industry & Business Analysis:

Evaluate the borrower's industry, market position, competitive environment, business risks, customer concentration, supplier dependency, and other external factors that may affect repayment capacity.

Portfolio Monitoring:

Monitor existing corporate loan accounts, repayment behaviour, financial performance, covenant compliance, credit exposure, asset quality, and early warning signals.

Risk Identification & Mitigation:

Identify potential credit risks and recommend appropriate risk-mitigation measures, including suitable security, covenants, guarantees, limits, repayment structures, and monitoring requirements.

Regulatory & Policy Compliance:

Ensure credit assessments and lending decisions are aligned with the company's internal credit policies, risk framework, lending guidelines, and applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.

Coordination:

Coordinate with Sales, Relationship Managers, Operations, Legal, Compliance, Collections, and other relevant teams to ensure efficient processing and monitoring of corporate credit facilities.

Skills Required

- Strong knowledge of corporate credit analysis and lending processes.

- Strong financial statement analysis and interpretation skills.

- Good understanding of corporate loans, working capital facilities, term loans, and other business lending products.

- Ability to analyse cash flows and assess debt-servicing capacity.

- Strong knowledge of financial ratios, including DSCR, Debt/Equity, Interest Coverage Ratio, Current Ratio, and other credit metrics.

- Good understanding of collateral, securities, guarantees, and credit risk mitigation.

- Strong MS Excel and financial modelling skills.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to identify financial and business risks.

- Good communication and report-writing skills.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

- Strong decision-making and risk-assessment skills.

Key Performance Areas (KPIs)

- Accuracy and quality of corporate credit assessments.

- Timely completion of credit appraisal and recommendations.

- Quality of financial analysis and risk identification.

- Accuracy of financial models and credit reports.

- Effective identification and mitigation of credit risks.

- Portfolio quality and monitoring of existing corporate accounts.

- Compliance with internal credit policies and regulatory requirements.

- Timely identification of early warning signals.

- Accuracy and completeness of credit documentation.

- Turnaround time for credit assessment and decision-making.

Interested Candidates

Interested candidates can share their updated CV with the HR team.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

* Optimize automation in release workflows using enterprise grade tools and scripts to reduce manual intervention shorten cycle times and minimize human error during deployments

Job Description: Home Loan Relationship Manager – Real Estate

Position: Home Loan Relationship Manager

Department: Sales / Customer Finance / Home Loan Desk

Industry: Real Estate

Experience: 2–6 years in home loans, mortgage sales, banking, NBFC, housing finance, or real estate customer finance.

Job Summary:

We are looking for a customer-focused and target-oriented Home Loan Relationship Manager to manage the home loan requirements of customers purchasing residential properties.

The role will be responsible for coordinating with customers, banks, NBFCs, and internal sales teams to facilitate the complete home loan process—from initial eligibility assessment and documentation through sanction and disbursement.

The candidate will also be responsible for building strong relationships with lending partners, improving loan conversion rates, and ensuring a smooth customer experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Customer Relationship Management:**

* Understand customers' home loan requirements and financial profiles.
* Explain available home loan options, eligibility criteria, interest rates, tenure, and documentation requirements.
* Assist customers in selecting suitable lending options based on their requirements.
* Maintain regular communication with customers throughout the loan process.
* Address customer queries and resolve loan-related issues promptly.

**2. Home Loan Processing:**

* Manage the complete home loan journey from application to disbursement.
* Collect and verify required customer documents.
* Coordinate with banks/NBFCs for login, credit assessment, sanction, and disbursement.
* Track applications and ensure timely movement of files through different stages.
* Follow up on pending documentation, credit queries, legal/technical requirements, and sanction conditions.
* Ensure timely disbursement in coordination with the customer and internal teams.

**3. Real Estate Sales Coordination:**

* Work closely with the property sales team to identify customers requiring home loan assistance.
* Attend customer meetings and property-site visits when required.
* Provide loan eligibility support to prospective buyers.
* Help sales teams understand customers' financing capabilities.
* Support the sales team in improving booking-to-disbursement conversion.
* Ensure loan-related concerns do not delay property transactions.

**4. Bank & NBFC Relationship Management:**

* Maintain strong working relationships with banks and housing finance companies.
* Coordinate with relationship managers, credit teams, legal teams, and operations teams of lending institutions.
* Negotiate and facilitate preferential processing wherever applicable.
* Maintain an updated understanding of lender policies, products, rates, and eligibility criteria.
* Identify suitable lending partners for different customer profiles.

**5. Loan Eligibility & Financial Assessment:**

* Conduct preliminary home loan eligibility assessments.
* Review customer income, employment/business profile, existing liabilities, credit history, and required loan amount.
* Calculate approximate eligibility and EMI requirements.
* Identify potential documentation or eligibility issues at an early stage.
* Recommend appropriate lender options based on customer profiles.

**6. Documentation & Compliance:**

* Ensure accurate collection and submission of KYC, income, banking, property, and other required documents.
* Coordinate with internal legal/CRM teams and lenders for property-related documentation.
* Maintain proper records of loan applications and customer communication.
* Ensure all processes comply with applicable company and lender policies.

**7. Sales & Business Development:**

* Achieve monthly targets for home loan applications, sanctions, and disbursements.
* Generate business through property sales leads, referrals, existing customers, and lending partners.
* Track loan conversion ratios and identify opportunities to improve performance.
* Promote relevant financial products offered through approved lending partners.
* Develop relationships with customers and referral sources to generate repeat business.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

* Home loan applications logged
* Sanction value
* Disbursement value
* Loan conversion rate
* Booking-to-loan conversion
* Average turnaround time
* Application-to-sanction ratio
* Sanction-to-disbursement ratio
* Customer satisfaction
* Pending application ageing
* Bank/NBFC partner productivity
* Monthly business achievement

**Required Skills:**

* Strong knowledge of home loans and mortgage processes.
* Understanding of banking/NBFC lending practices.
* Good knowledge of home loan eligibility and documentation.
* Strong customer relationship and communication skills.
* Good negotiation and follow-up skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders.
* Target-oriented and commercially driven approach.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel and CRM systems.
* Strong problem-solving and organizational skills.

**Educational Qualification:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM in Finance, Sales, or Marketing is an advantage.
* Preferred Experience

**Candidates with experience in:**

* Home loans / mortgage sales
* Banks and housing finance companies
* NBFCs
* Real estate developers
* Property sales support
* Loan processing / mortgage operations
* DSA / channel sales
* will be preferred.

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager - myRico
jobs.description:
Product Manager - myRico

HSR, Bangalore, India

**Mission**

The best teams spend too much time keeping work moving. Context is scattered across conversations, documents and tools. Decisions get lost. Dependencies go unnoticed. Someone has to remember what matters, connect the dots and follow through.

We’re building myRico to help carry that work.

Our ambition is an AI teammate that understands your company—its goals, people, decisions and ways of working—and uses that understanding to help the team get things done. A teammate that earns trust through useful work, sound judgment and dependable follow-through.

Our starting point is helping software teams move projects from intent to delivery. Success means less effort spent coordinating and correcting work, and a shorter path to an outcome the team can stand behind.

**The role**

We’re hiring our founding Product Manager to help turn that ambition into a product that teams rely on every day.

You’ll work closely with the founders, engineers and early customers to figure out where Rico creates the most value, what we should build next and whether it actually works. You’ll own the loop from understanding a problem to shipping a solution, watching people use it and making it better.

Some of the hardest questions are also the most interesting. When should Rico act on its own? When should it ask? What should it remember? How does it earn permission to take on more responsibility? How do we know it has saved someone time once we account for the effort of directing, reviewing and correcting it?

In practice, you might spend a morning watching a customer run a project, prototype a better workflow that afternoon, and work with engineering to put it in their hands that week. You’ll read conversations, investigate failures, challenge assumptions and make the small product decisions that determine whether an AI teammate feels useful or exhausting.

You’ll help shape both the product and how we build it. That means choosing a few problems worth solving deeply, making clear tradeoffs and staying accountable for what happens after launch.

This role is based in Bangalore and would require 5 days in office.

**What we’re looking for**

* **Customer obsession.** You get close enough to users to understand how their work actually happens, including the workarounds they’ve stopped noticing.
* **Product judgment.** You can turn an ambiguous problem into a clear decision about what to build, what to leave out and what evidence would change your mind.
* **A builder’s instinct.** You use prototypes, experiments and AI tools to make ideas tangible and learn quickly.
* **Technical fluency.** You can reason with engineers about AI behavior, memory, integrations, permissions and the tradeoffs between quality, latency and cost.
* **Care for the details.** You notice when an interaction creates confusion, a notification interrupts at the wrong time or a confident answer hasn’t earned that confidence.
* **Ownership.** You follow a problem through discovery, delivery and adoption. You stay with it when the first solution falls short.
* **Clear communication.** You write precisely, explain your reasoning and disagree thoughtfully.

**Experience**

You’ve helped take a product or meaningful feature from an unclear problem to real usage. You can explain the decisions you made, the tradeoffs you accepted and what you learned when users surprised you.

Your background might be product management, engineering, design or founding a company. We care about evidence of good judgment and useful things you’ve shipped.

This role will be a poor fit if

* You need a fully defined roadmap before you can make progress.
* You prefer handing off requirements to staying involved through implementation and adoption.
* You’re uncomfortable spending substantial time with customers or examining where the product fails.
* You find it difficult to change direction when the evidence challenges your original idea.

Bonus

* You’ve built an AI product and dealt with its behavior in real use.
* You’ve worked on collaboration tools, developer products or complex business workflows.
* You’ve been a founder or an early employee at a startup.
* You can build working prototypes yourself.

We are hiring a Sr. Data Product Manager to own a portfolio of Target Media data products end-to-end — from business definitions and contracts through datasets, pipelines, quality, governance, and delivery.

The core job is to translate technical capability into business outcomes. You will sit at the intersection of Roundel product, Data Engineering, MediaOps, and the broader Media Data Consumers.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**
We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager — Measurement & Analytics to lead the strategy, development, and evolution of data products that enable marketing measurement and attribution across Target Media.
  
  
**Measurement – Must Have**
This role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing Measurement, Analytics and Data Engineering. You will own products that help the organization understand the impact of marketing investments across channels, campaigns, audiences, and customer journeys.
  
  
The initial focus will be on Roundel and Target marketing spend, with the opportunity to expand measurement capabilities across loyalty, promotions, and other enterprise marketing investments.
  
  
A core responsibility will be building and scaling attribution and measurement capabilities that connect marketing exposure and spend to business outcomes, enabling stakeholders to understand what worked, why it worked, and where to invest next.
  
  
Analytics & Data Fluency — Must Have
  
  
Strong Working Knowledge Of Analytics And Data Concepts, With The Ability To Partner Effectively With Analytics Teams. You Should Be Comfortable With
  
  

* Customer-level and aggregated analytics

* Data pipelines and data transformations

Building data products with Data Engineering
  
  
You work hand-in-hand with Data Engineering to turn requirements into real datasets and pipelines — translating business needs into clear specs, prioritizing the backlog, and making trade-off calls with DE on design and sequencing.
  
  
Platform & ecosystem stewardship
  
  
Solid understand of Data Platform, cloud environment of GCP/BQ/PowerBI

jobs.description:
**About BabyBillion**

BabyBillion is a safe, smart, and engaging learning platform for children aged 2-8. We bring together videos, games, and interactive learning in an ad-free, parent-friendly app. We're looking for a Product Manager to own the user journey, from a parent discovering the app and starting a trial to their child building a regular learning habit. You'll work closely with the leadership, engineering, design, content, and growth teams to turn user insights into measurable product improvements.

**What you'll own**

**Onboarding and conversion:**
Simplify onboarding, communicate the app's value, and improve install-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion.

**Retention and subscriptions**
: Improve the subscription experience, payment journeys, renewals, and monthly paid-user retention.

**Content discovery**
: Help children find relevant videos, categories, and playlists through better homepage layouts, recommendations, search, and navigation.

**Meaningful engagement:**
Build age-appropriate games, interactive experiences, and gamification that encourage learning and repeat usage.

**Product roadmap**
: Identify the highest-impact problems, prioritise them, and own execution from discovery to launch and post-launch measurement.

**What you'll do**

• Speak with parents and study user behaviour to understand needs, friction, and reasons for dropping off.

• Analyse funnels, cohorts, content performance, and engagement data to identify opportunities. • Write clear PRDs, user flows, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.

• Work closely with designers and engineers to ship improvements, test releases, and resolve product issues.

• Run experiments and evaluate whether changes improve conversion, retention, and learning engagement.

• Partner with the content team to improve discovery and understand why strong content may receive limited exposure.

• Collaborate with growth on acquisition-to-payment journeys, attribution, and user quality.

• Keep child safety, age appropriateness, and parent trust central to product decisions.

**Tech team collaboration and delivery**

• Own the development cycle with the tech team, from requirements and design handoff through estimation, development, QA, release, and post-launch review.

• Manage Scrum ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Track action items and follow through on improvements.

• Maintain a prioritised backlog with clear user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a shared definition of done.

• Agree sprint goals, scope, timelines, and capacity with engineering. Balance new features, bugs, technical debt, and maintenance with the tech lead.

• Track sprint progress, surface blockers early, coordinate dependencies, and communicate delivery risks and scope changes to stakeholders.

• Plan releases with engineering, design, content, and growth; monitor issues after launch and coordinate fixes and product improvements.

• 1-5 years of experience in product management.

• Previous experience working on consumer apps, particularly in subscriptions, edtech, content, or gaming, is good to have.

• Strong understanding of conversion funnels, cohort analysis, retention, and experimentation.

• Comfort using product analytics tools and dashboards to identify problems and measure outcomes.

• Strong product judgement and the ability to simplify experiences for both parents and children.

• Clear communication, structured thinking, and hands-on execution.

• Ownership of outcomes, with the ability to prioritise and move quickly in a startup.

**How success will be measured**

• Higher install-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion.

• Better monthly paid-user retention and renewal rates.

• Increased daily active usage among paid users.

• Improved content discovery and meaningful time spent.

• Predictable sprint delivery, fewer unresolved blockers, and stable releases with measurable impact after launch.

You'll own core product decisions, work directly with leadership, and help shape how young children learn while building a consumer subscription business.

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager  - Media Measurements
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Sr. Data Product Manager to own a portfolio of Target Media data products end-to-end — from business definitions and contracts through datasets, pipelines, quality, governance, and delivery.
  
  
This is a hands-on role that works closely with Data Engineering, Analytics and Media Partners. You will partner with DE day-to-day to build and evolve datasets and pipelines across a medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture, shape schemas and contracts, and make sure the data products that result are trusted and well-governed. The core job is to translate technical capability into business outcomes. You will sit at the intersection of Roundel product, Data Engineering, MediaOps, and the broader Media Data Consumers.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**
We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager — Measurement & Analytics to lead the strategy, development, and evolution of data products that enable marketing measurement and attribution across Target Media.
  
  
**Measurement – Must Have**
This role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing Measurement, Analytics and Data Engineering. You will own products that help the organization understand the impact of marketing investments across channels, campaigns, audiences, and customer journeys.
  
  
The initial focus will be on Roundel and Target marketing spend, with the opportunity to expand measurement capabilities across loyalty, promotions, and other enterprise marketing investments.
  
  
A core responsibility will be building and scaling attribution and measurement capabilities that connect marketing exposure and spend to business outcomes, enabling stakeholders to understand what worked, why it worked, and where to invest next.
  
  
Analytics & Data Fluency — Must Have
  
  
Strong Working Knowledge Of Analytics And Data Concepts, With The Ability To Partner Effectively With Analytics Teams. You Should Be Comfortable With
  
  

* Customer-level and aggregated analytics
* Data aggregation and dimensional modelling
* Data pipelines and data transformations
* Data quality and reconciliation
* Metric definitions and semantic layers

Building data products with Data Engineering
  
  
You work hand-in-hand with Data Engineering to turn requirements into real datasets and pipelines — translating business needs into clear specs, prioritizing the backlog, and making trade-off calls with DE on design and sequencing.
  
  
Platform & ecosystem stewardship
  
  
Solid understand of Data Platform, cloud environment of GCP/BQ/PowerBI
  
  
Trust, governance & data quality — critical
  
  
Data governance and data quality are central to this role, not an afterthought. As operational systems and automated workflows act on Roundel data, the cost of a stale or wrong data product rises sharply.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years in product management, with meaningful time across Measurement, data products, data platforms, AdTech/MarTech, or retail media.
* Proven understanding Marketing Measurement concepts of Attribution, MTA, MMM, etc.
* Hands-on experience working closely with Data Engineering to build datasets and pipelines — writing specs, shaping schemas and contracts, and prioritizing a technical backlog.
* Solid understanding of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and modern data platforms (Lakehouse, data mesh, or federated architectures), including lineage and cost.
* Strong grasp of data governance and data quality — certification, monitoring, access, and consent — treated as critical, not optional.
* Track record of translating technical capability into measurable business outcomes and influencing cross-functional partners without direct authority.
* Strong understand if PM Practices and working with Data Engineering, Analysts and Stakeholders.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Job Description**
Product Strategy & Roadmap
  
  

* Own overall product strategy and roadmap for core streaming products (DCR, SPR, SCR) end-to-end, with the goal to improve the overall customer experience metrics and optimize and scale product enhancements by identifying simplifiers that contribute to overall OE.
* Conduct ongoing market analysis of the streaming, TV, and digital video ecosystem to surface insights on emerging trends, competitor positioning, and client needs.
* Maintain a prioritized product backlog grounded in customer pain-points, data signals, and quarterly strategy documents — not feature requests in isolation.
* Translate SVP-level vision into executable roadmap milestones with clear owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

Product Development & Delivery
  
  

* Lead prototype-first development cycles: ship working artifacts early, use demos to drive alignment, and produce written specs as a downstream artifact.
* Partner with Engineering, Data Science, and Global Data Solutions to drive timely, high-quality delivery of product increments across the full lifecycle — from requirements and design through QA and launch.
* Define user stories, acceptance criteria, and API/data specs; serve as the primary day-to-day product contact for engineering teams.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Go-to-Market
  
  

* Collaborate with Sales, Client Success, and Marketing to develop go-to-market strategies, pricing inputs, and client onboarding materials for new product features and module launches.
* Engage key internal and external stakeholders — including clients, industry partners, and industry associations — to ensure product decisions reflect real-world needs and support enterprise deal cycles.
* Represent the Content Product team across cross-functional forums; communicate priorities, trade-offs, and progress clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Serve as a subject matter expert in video content measurement, contributing to external thought leadership, client conversations, and industry forums as needed.

Quality, Measurement & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Uphold Nielsen’s gold-standard history of data accuracy, neutrality, and methodological rigor across all product decisions and launches.
* Define and track KPIs across the product success dimensions: time-to-value, D30/W12 retention, expansion revenue, and compounding moat metrics.
* Implement rigorous quality assurance processes to ensure the accuracy and reliability of Nielsen’s content measurement data.
* Identify and address operational bottlenecks in development processes to improve team velocity without quality regressions.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years in technical product management roles
* 3+ years in a principal (or equivalent) product role owning an enterprise, revenue-impacting product
* Proven ownership of a revenue/retention/expansion metric
* Direct engineering/data science partnership experience, "player-coach" style
* Media measurement/streaming/TV/adtech experience preferred
* Track record in lean, high-autonomy team structures

Education
  
  

* Engineering, CS, Software Development, or related technical field preferred
* 10+ years in a technical PM role accepted in lieu of a technical degree
* MBA/MS a plus, not required

Skills & Competencies
  
  

* AI-fluency, technical credibility, data-driven decision-making, executive communication, ambiguity management, enterprise B2B/GTM experience

**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

jobs.title: Lead Business System Analyst: E-Comm and Enterprise Applications
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly versatile and experienced Lead Business Systems Analyst to join our Enterprise Applications team. This role will primarily support Salesforce B2B E-commerce, Salesforce Service Cloud, and related enterprise applications used across E-commerce, Customer Service, and DCS business operations.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a strong business analyst and solution partner who can understand complex business problems, translate them into scalable technology solutions, and work across multiple systems, stakeholders, and delivery teams. This role requires someone who is not limited to a single platform but can quickly understand business processes, system capabilities, data flows, integrations, and operational dependencies.
  
  
This person will partner with business stakeholders, architects, developers, BSAs, and application owners to define requirements, shape solutions, manage delivery backlogs, and drive business value through process improvement, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as a trusted partner to business stakeholders to understand, analyze, and solve complex business problems across E-commerce, Customer Service, and DCS operations.
* Lead business analysis and solution definition for Salesforce B2B e-commerce, Salesforce Service Cloud, and related enterprise applications.
* Work closely with business groups, senior stakeholders, application owners, architects, developers, and BSAs to define scalable and supportable solutions.
* Facilitate discovery sessions, workshops, process reviews, and solution discussions to align stakeholders on business needs, requirements, priorities, and implementation approach.

* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities.

+ Salesforce AI capabilities such as Agentforce, Data Cloud
+ AI-assisted insights, recommendations, and workflow automation.
+ Gong insights to improve sales effectiveness and customer interactions

+ Automation tools such as Slack workflows or similar productivity solutions

* Collaborate with QA, business users, and delivery teams to support test planning, UAT, release readiness, user adoption, and hypercare activities.

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* Strong hands-on experience working with Salesforce applications, especially:

+ Salesforce Commerce Cloud, including B2B, B2C, or B2B2C commerce models
+ Salesforce Service Cloud
+ Salesforce Sales Cloud

* Strong understanding of e-commerce, customer service, case management, customer/account data, and order management business processes.
* Experience writing functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, business process flows, data mapping documents, and system interaction documentation.
* Experience working with cross-functional delivery teams, including business stakeholders, architects, developers, QA teams, product owners, and application support teams.
* Exposure to enterprise integration concepts and patterns, including REST APIs, SOAP APIs, middleware, data synchronization, and cross-system dependencies.
* Ability to analyze complex business problems and recommend scalable, practical, and maintainable solutions.
* Strong communication, facilitation, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Experience managing and prioritizing delivery backlogs using Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with ITSM concepts, operational support processes, incident management, change management, and service delivery practices.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Salesforce Agentforce, Data Cloud, or other Salesforce AI capabilities.
* Experience identifying or enabling AI, automation, analytics, or productivity use cases in enterprise business applications.
* Exposure to Gong or similar sales intelligence/customer interaction platforms.
* Experience with Tableau dashboards, reporting, and business analytics.
* Familiarity with Slack workflows, automation tools, or enterprise productivity platforms.
* Experience working in a complex enterprise application ecosystem involving Salesforce, SAP/order management systems, customer support tools, reporting platforms, and integration layers.
* Experience supporting global business teams and working with distributed delivery teams.

jobs.title: AVP-Business Analysis
jobs.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* 7+ years of experience in business analysis, product analysis, credit analysis, digital assets, financial technology, capital markets or structured finance
* Strong understanding of digital asset market structure, tokenization, stablecoins, distributed ledger technologies and digital market infrastructure
* Experience defining workflows, operating models, requirements and delivery roadmaps in a cross-functional environment
* Extensive experience working with distributed ledger technologies, including permissioned and permissionless networks, decentralized finance protocols, node infrastructure and blockchain oracles
* Extensive experience with data requirements, data mapping, data modeling and familiarity with data standards (ISO, Token standards) along with working knowledge of structured and unstructured on-chain and off-chain data sources
* Ability to translate complex analytical, market and business concepts into scalable operating capabilities and strategic initiatives
* Strong analytical thinking, stakeholder coordination and written communication skills
* Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency, supported by awareness of AI risk management and responsible and ethical AI use

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience in finance, economics, business, technology, engineering, data analytics or a related field

**Responsibilities**
Help shape and scale digital economy capabilities that deliver credit-relevant insights across evolving financial markets.
  
  

* Support the evolution of digital economy capabilities by identifying opportunities to extend analytical insights into emerging market structures and distribution channels
* Translate strategic priorities and business requirements into scalable operating capabilities that support long-term growth and adoption
* Partner with analytical, technology, risk, commercial and operational stakeholders to align priorities, sequencing and delivery objectives
* Establish structured processes for evaluating, prioritizing and advancing strategic opportunities across the digital economy landscape
* Analyze developments across digital assets, tokenization and market infrastructure to identify opportunities for new analytical capabilities
* Evaluate opportunities to use emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and advanced analytics, to enhance business processes and analytical capabilities
* Contribute to research, publications, educational materials and internal perspectives on digital assets, technology innovation and credit considerations
* Support senior leadership by translating complex strategic, market and operational considerations into actionable recommendations

**About The Team**
Our Digital Economy team within Moody’s Ratings supports the firm’s strategy for innovative technologies including digital assets, tokenization, decentralized finance, stablecoins, on-chain infrastructure and data-driven innovation. The team works across analytical, technology, risk oversight, commercial and operational functions to develop scalable capabilities that help Moody’s Ratings understand, assess, ingest and deliver credit-relevant insights in digital financial markets. By joining the team, you will contribute to work at the intersection of strategy, innovation, analytics and business transformation, with direct engagement on initiatives that strengthen readiness for an increasingly digital financial ecosystem and support responsible use of emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence and advanced analytics.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:

**Business Analyst**

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Cyber and Data Resilience
jobs.description:

This role will play a critical part in ensuring high-quality sales data, producing reliable reports, and translating sales activity into clear, actionable insights for leadership decision-making.
  
  
Based in Bangalore, this role is designed for an analyst with 2+ years of experience who is comfortable working with structured data, collaborating with global stakeholders, and operating in a process-driven, high-accountability environment.
  
  
**Day To Day Responsibilities**
Salesforce Data Quality & Governance

Sales & Performance Insights

* Familiarity with sales KPIs such as pipeline, win rate, average deal size, and sales cycle metrics.
